bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are permitted and searched; nonclear bags may receive additional screening. Backpacks and drawstring bags are barred.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue advises using street parking where available and following posted signs. AutoZone, Club Carnaval and Taco More lots tow or boot unauthorized vehicles.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue recommends rideshare and directs drop-offs to the front of its security screening lanes.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Beer, wine, spirits and nonalcoholic beverages are sold throughout the venue. Transactions are cashless and accept major cards and Apple Pay.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The main entrance is accessible. Accessible viewing is first come first served, accessible stalls are in all restrooms, and accessible parking is in front of the main entrance by security.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue does not allow guests to leave and return during a show.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The Emo’s box office opens when doors open on show days, but the venue guide does not set out a separate will-call ticket pickup process.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The box office opens at doors on show days, and security screening takes place at the main entrance. Check the show listing for its exact door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
